name: Omakuchi Narasimhan
bio: Narasimhan, popularly known as Omakuchi, was an Indian stage and film actor. He acted in over 1,500 films in 14 Indian languages.

credits.title: Suvadugal
credits.overview: After his father's untimely death, Kannan (Jayabala), an affluent young man, is hounded by a rival landlord (Rajesh) who wants to completely run him into the ground. Will Kannan be able to stand up to his adversary?

credits.title: Thalai Nagaram
credits.overview: After Right, a petty criminal, kills Bhai's son, Bhai's gangsters seek revenge by killing Right's friend Balu. Later, Right decides to lead a normal life, but a corrupt police officer exploits him.

credits.title: Gemini
credits.overview: Gemini, a gangster, falls for Manisha who reciprocates his love without knowing his truth. After getting arrested and completing his term, he tries to convince his lover that he is a changed man.

credits.title: Nayak: The Real Hero
credits.overview: Shivajirao, a TV reporter, gets a chance to be the Chief Minister of Maharashtra for a day after being challenged by incumbent Chief Minister Balraj Chauhan. After his one-day stint turns out to be a huge success, his life spirals out of control and he is embroiled in political intrigue.

credits.title: Kunguma Pottu Gounder
credits.overview: Kandasamy is desperate to enrol his son in a good school. Trouble ensues when his wife spots him with an educated woman who is posing as their child's mother in order to help him get admission.

credits.title: Nee Enthan Vaanam
credits.overview: Sathya and Alex, who are assigned to catch a team of terrorists, stay with a tribe in a forest. However, things take a turn when someone begins killing the tribal women.

credits.title: Budget Padmanabhan
credits.overview: Padmanabhan has earned the nickname Budget as he is a miser. However, he struggles to save his father's house from money lenders as his wife is a spendthrift and never lets him save enough.

credits.title: Mudhalvan
credits.overview: A man accepts a challenge to act as the Chief Minister for one day only, and makes such a success of it that soon he is embroiled in political intrigue.

credits.title: Kumbakonam Gopalu
credits.overview: Gopal, a man from a small town, earns a living in the city by cheating people in all possible ways. He decides to make big money by blackmailing the men involved in a woman's death. What transpires later forms the crux of the story.

credits.title: Kadhala Kadhala
credits.overview: Two friends, both with the name of Lingam, create a comedy of errors and consequent chaos with their girlfriends and their families.

credits.title: Ratchagan
credits.overview: A girl falls for a violent man, who keeps taking law in his hands and beats people up. She wants to marry to him and eventually even he says yes, but her father has a condition that he should control his anger and work with him in his factory.

credits.title: Aahaa Enna Porutham
credits.overview: Kunju Gounder is a respected village chief, he seeks his missed son. Panju Gounder, worked as a servant in Kunju Gounder's house and married his sister. Now, Panju Gounder tries hard to be respected by the villagers. Raja and his friend are fraud. Raja attempts to make himself out to be Kunju Gounder's son and falls in

credits.title: Thaali Pudhusu
credits.overview: Arun falls in love at first sight with a bank cashier Seetha and follow her everywhere. Seetha refuses his love and tells him her past. In the past, Seetha was from a middle-class family. Seetha's brother-in-law was a jobless, and lived with them. Balu was a bank manager and falls in love with Seetha. Mani, Balu's fath

credits.title: Indian
credits.overview: Senapathy, an ex-freedom fighter, is angry. He is angry against the rampant corruption at every level of the bureaucracy. He will clean it up at any cost.

credits.title: Meendum Savithri
credits.overview: Manju is an outspoken woman. She lives with her father, who tries to socially reform people. Belonging to a middle class family, she cannot provide a dowry for potential grooms. One day, Manju comes across an innovative advertisement where a groom is looking for a bride without any dowry. His family shocks Manju's fath

credits.title: Thirumoorthy
credits.overview: Moorthy is a lorry driver, who lives with his mother Ramaatha and often confronts the criminal Govindan. Moorthy and Uma fall in love with each other. One day, her father has a heart attack, when Moorthy and Uma rush him to the hospital the roads were blocked by a local political party. Her father unfortunately dies, t

credits.title: Periya Marudhu
credits.overview: Periya Marudhu remains a loyal henchman to Sivasankaran attracting the villagers' ire. However, his life changes when Kaveri comes to stay with him, and he falls in love with her.

credits.title: Sabash Babu
credits.overview: Lalitha becomes extremely disturbed after she loses her newborn child. However, when she meets Babu, an orphan, she finds another reason to live and that is to raise the boy.

credits.title: Gentleman
credits.overview: Kicha is a modern-day Robin Hood, who along with his friend, Mani, steals from the rich to aid the poor. In society, he is a respected man who runs a small business.

credits.title: Pass Mark
credits.overview: Murali, a playful youngster, makes quick money by challenging others. But when one of his challenges goes haywire, it ruins a girl's wedding, and he decides to make it up to her.

credits.title: Naalaya Seidhi
credits.overview: Manmadan investigates the case of a dead officer and ends up falling in love with the daughter of the deceased man. Soon, he suspects that there is a larger conspiracy that needs his attention.

credits.title: Suriyan
credits.overview: The CBI is in search of Suriyan, an intelligent security officer of central ministry, who is accused of murdering a central minister. He hides his identity and takes shelter in a remote village.

credits.title: Athisaya Piravi
credits.overview: Kalicharan is killed by goons. In heaven, he opposes and gets sent back in the body of Balwant, who has enemies in the form of greedy relatives. Now, he has to fix Balwant's life as well as his own.

credits.title: Periya Idathu Pillai
credits.overview: Vijay is in love with Geetha but is unable to marry her due to her father's disapproval. Eventually, he gets married to Lakshmi who has a dark past with Geetha's fiance, Anand.

credits.title: Pudhu Vasantham
credits.overview: Gowri, a woman in search of her lover Suresh, joins a group of struggling roadside singers. Friendship grows between them as they achieve success, but things change when Suresh returns.

credits.title: Kalyana Rasi
credits.overview: Sulochana dislikes military men but falls in love with Murali, a soldier, when he rescues her from a thug. Meanwhile, Sulochana's father fixes the marriage of his second daughter with Murali.

credits.title: Varavu Nalla Uravu
credits.overview: Two friends, Ambalavanan and Chandrashekar, have very different perspectives on life. While one thrives amidst his loving family, the other believes that everything revolves around money.

credits.title: Salem Vishnu
credits.overview: Vishnu, a clever student but intolerant to cheating, is detained from college. He then becomes a car mechanic, but his life starts to change when his brother is transferred to the same city.

credits.title: Nalla Kaalam Porandaachu
credits.overview: Trying to save his blind mother Shenbagam by a transplant, Muthu discovers that his father Asogan is alive and has been waiting on death row, his execution not for a long time.

credits.title: Sonthakkaran
credits.overview: After sending an evil man to prison for rape and murder, an honest cop loses his job on false allegations. Soon, his old nemesis returns for revenge.

credits.title: Manamagale Vaa
credits.overview: In order to resolve her sister, Geetha's marital problems, Chitra decides to marry Geetha's bachelor brother-in-law, Balu. She disguises herself as a village belle, Rajathi and enters Balu's life.

credits.title: Thaimel Aanai
credits.overview: Raja, a young man, is determined to avenge the death of his mother and sister. But, his friend, a law abiding police officer, does not want Raja to take law into his own hands.

credits.title: Penmani Aval Kanmani
credits.overview: Parandhaman and his family are forced to shift to another house due to his father's habit of interfering in the neighbours' affairs. His father tries to solve people's problems by staging events.

credits.title: Coolikkaran
credits.overview: Raja lives with his elder brother, sister-in-law, and their little daughter.  Rajabecomes a coolie and transports articles. He is jailed for smuggling. His brother gets into an accident at work at the mill and loses his arms. He loses his job and needs money for treatment. Raja begs his brother's boss , but he refuses.

credits.title: Kavalan Avan Kovalan
credits.overview: Pachiappan loves Anjala but cannot marry her till he makes a name for himself. He finds an opportunity when he meets Chakravorthy, his lookalike and a popular director.

credits.title: Neethikku Thandanai
credits.overview: A 1987 Indian Tamil film, directed by S. A. Chandrasekhar and produced by S. S. Neelakantan and Shoba Chandrasekhar.

credits.title: Velaikkaran
credits.overview: Ragupathy leaves his village for the city and finds a job at a 5-star hotel owned by a man in a relationship with his mother. When his life is threatened, Ragupathy decides to ensure his safety.

credits.title: Shankar Guru
credits.overview: Shankar Guru is a 1987 Indian Tamil film, directed by Raja and produced by M. Saravanan and M. Balasubramanian. The film stars Arjun, Seetha, Sasikala and Baby Shalini in lead roles. The film had musical score by Chandra Bose.

credits.title: Thirumathi Oru Vegumathi
credits.overview: Uma and her husband make many sacrifices, including not having children, to raise Uma's younger brothers. However, with time, the brothers get immersed in their lives and stop caring for their sister.

credits.title: Kizhakku Africavil Sheela
credits.overview: Story features an affluent couple, who venture into a forest to serve the tribal groups. Unfortunately, they die leaving behind their infant daughter Sheela, who gets nurtured amongst the wild.

credits.title: Odangal
credits.overview: Gopal and Radha fall in love, unaware that their fathers are political foes and are always at loggerheads. Defying them, the duo elopes to get married only to live amidst fear and insecurity.

credits.title: Samsaram Adhu Minsaram
credits.overview: Ammaiyappan Mudaliar fulfils every need of his four children. However, when the eldest son fights with him and leaves the house, Uma, the daughter-in-law, tries to solve their issues.

credits.title: December Pookkal
credits.overview: Annam, a journalist, loves Chandru, an ace painter who recently lost his wife Uma in an accident. Vinodh, a police officer, investigates murders and discovers that Annam is next on the hit list.

credits.title: Mr. Bharath
credits.overview: Businessman Gopinath abandons Shanti, his first love, to marry a rich heiress. Later, Bharath, Gopinath and Shanti's illegitimate son, seeks revenge from him for the injustice meted out to his mother.

credits.title: Aan Paavam
credits.overview: A young man travels to a village to meet the girl his father has arranged for him to marry. He mistakenly visits the wrong family and marries their daughter, who was waiting for her arranged husband to arrive.

credits.title: Navagraha Naayagi
credits.overview: Goddess Maari Amman blesses those who sincerely pray to her and teaches a lesson to those who are involved in wrong doings by performing miracles and healing.

credits.title: Osai
credits.overview: Raja, a poor man, falls in love with Radha. Radha's uncle is in debt and looks for a rich guy to settle his debt. Raja lies about his background but gets exposed.

credits.title: Sukradesai
credits.overview: Kannan has faced consecutive failures in his life. His fortunes take a turn when he is saved by his exceptionally loyal and smart dog, Bhairava. The dog's clever antics eventually land it roles in movies, transforming Kannan into a wealthy yet humble man.

credits.title: Thambikku Entha Ooru
credits.overview: Seeing Balu's spendthrift and carefree attitude, his father sends him to his friend's house in a village to get reformed. Things get complicated when he gets entangled in a love triangle.

credits.title: Oorukku Upadesam
credits.overview: Janaki tries to prove her innocence when her brother-in-law accuses her of being a sex worker. Meanwhile, Janaki's uncle discovers that she has a lookalike.

credits.title: Dowry Kalyanam
credits.overview: Friends Ganeshan and Ethiraj have a falling out due to a misunderstanding. However, when Ganeshan is close to losing all his wealth due to his sister's marriage, he is forced to reach out to Ethiraj.

credits.title: Sakalakala Vallavan
credits.overview: A young agriculturalist goes to extremes to attain revenge against his devious landlord and his family.

credits.title: Pokkiri Raja
credits.overview: Ramesh joins a businessman's factory to eradicate irregularity and corruption, but gets dismissed due to personal reasons. To make matters worse, he is framed for murder when the industrialist dies.

credits.title: Kudumbam Oru Kadambam
credits.overview: Three middle-class families living in Chennai face several difficulties in their everyday lives and tackle the challenges that come their way.

credits.title: Ellam Un Kairasi
credits.overview: A mechanic, constantly gets into a brawl with a well-known smuggler. All hell breaks loose, when he discovers that the smuggler is none other than his father, who alienated him.

credits.title: Manthoppu Kiliye
credits.overview: Arun and Jayanti are a greedy couple who like living a lavish lifestyle. However, when Arun's employer begins to express interest in Jayanti, she realises that her husband has sold her for money.
